formula: F = k · |q₁·q₂| / r²   avec  k = 1/(4π·ε₀) ≈ 9·10⁹ N·m²/C²
sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with two point charges q₁, q₂ at seeded positions
on a metric grid. Force vector F₁₂ drawn on q₂ (arrow length ∝ |F|,
color coded by attraction/repulsion). HUD readouts: r (cm), q₁, q₂
(μC or nC), |F| in N via F = k·|q₁q₂|/r². Student drags either charge
in 2D and toggles each charge's sign; slider adjusts |q|. Experiment:
given target force magnitude and direction on q₂, choose r and
charges to match. Evaluate: force arrow hidden — student places
charges to achieve a target |F| (readout kept). Wrinkle: k = 9·10⁹
N·m²/C² baked in; charges in μC to keep numeric scale tractable.
